Definition: {a spread of the hand, i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)}
BiblicalUsage: A handbreadth is the measure of the tabernacle's furniture. The table's border was a handbreadth round about, and the measuring reed in Ezekiel's vision counted by the cubit and a handbreadth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the small measure matters: God's house was built to the breadth of a hand, and nothing in it was left to guesswork.
